caption: The drawing features a single ceramic jug centered within a light rectangular border. The jug is bulbous and tapers to a short, cylindrical neck with a slightly wider lip at the top. The overall color of the jug is a muted tan or beige, with brownish shading suggesting contours and light reflection. On the front of the jug, there is a blue decorative motif depicting two stylized flowers with leaves and stems. Above this design, the text "MANTELL & THOMAS PENN YAN 3" is written in blue capital letters. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, inset illustration of the jug's upper section showing a side view, highlighting a single curved handle attached to the neck and shoulder. The background is plain with no additional objects.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
